_comment: warframe.market login for the order-touching scripts only. This file is gitignored - never commit it.
_comment_wfm_token: Optional, and the way past a browser check: sign in once in your OWN browser, then paste the JWT cookie here (F12 -> Application -> Cookies -> https://warframe.market -> JWT). The app then uses that session instead of the password sign-in. A verification code is never asked for, fetched, stored or logged by the app - the same thing AlecaFrame tells its users.
